title: ArtiMuse: Fine-Grained Image Aesthetics Assessment with Joint Scoring and Expert-Level Understanding

layout.note: A three-by-three grid in which the eight outer cells are numbered pastel cards (1, 2, 3 on the top row, 4 and 5 at the sides of the middle row, 6, 7, 8 on the bottom row) and the middle cell is an unframed radar chart with its legend box, flanked by three score-labelled sample images. Each card has a handwriting-style numbered title, a thumbnail and a critique paragraph.

lesson: Show a model's fine-grained outputs as a ring of equal cards, each a sample beside text with key phrases in one highlight colour, around a single summary chart that carries the quantitative claim, so qualitative breadth and quantitative superiority sit in one view.
